senses.gloss: m., אַחֲרוֹנָה f. (אַחֲרוֹנִית f. noun) other, next, last.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 21b">Meg. 21ᵇ</cite>; a. fr. <he>א׳</he> the last of those called up to read from the Torah.—Pl. <he>אַחֲרוֹנִים</he> m., <he>אַחֲרוֹנוֹת</he> f.—<he>מים א׳</he> the washing of hands after meals before grace, opp. <he>מים ראשונים</he> washihg before meals.
<cite ref="Berakhot 53b:32">Ber. 53ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—<he>דורות א׳</he> or only <he>אחרונים</he> the latter (present) generation, opp. <he>ראשונים</he> ancients.

<cite ref="Berakhot 13a">Ber. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>צרות א׳ וכ׳</he> the latter (present) troubles bring the former into oblivion.—(<he>ברכות</he>) <he>א׳</he> the three last sections in the Prayer of Benedictions.
